title: Hello World! Welcome to Micro Hearing Care Centre
author: Dr. Audiology Team, MHCC
excerpt: Welcome to our online hearing healthcare resource. Discover why early diagnosis of hearing loss is crucial and how digital micro technology restores natural clarity.
content:
Welcome to the official audiology blog of Micro Hearing Care Centre (MHCC) Bangladesh. Established in 2014, our mission has always been singular: Hearing means quality of life — Make better living.

Why Hearing Healthcare Matters More Than Ever

Hearing loss is one of the most common sensory impairments globally, yet it is often ignored in its earliest stages. In Bangladesh, individuals wait an average of 7 to 10 years after first noticing hearing difficulty before visiting a certified audiology clinic.

During these untreated years, the brain undergoes 'auditory deprivation'—the hearing nerve and brain cortex lose their ability to decipher complex speech patterns, leading to cognitive fatigue, social withdrawal, and communication strain in family and work life.

How Digital Micro Hearing Technology Changes Everything

Modern digital hearing aids are no longer the bulky, whistling analog amplifiers of past decades. Today's devices powered by Swiss (Phonak), German (Rexton), and Canadian (Unitron) engineering are essentially miniature supercomputers resting discreetly in or behind your ear:

  • AI-Powered Sound Separation: Automatically filters out cafe clatter, traffic rumble, or fan hum while bringing the voice of your conversation partner forward.
  • Binaural Directionality: Two hearing aids communicate wirelessly across your head to recreate natural 360-degree sound localization.
  • Direct Bluetooth Streaming: Stream phone calls, YouTube, and television audio directly into both ears with crystal-clear fidelity.
  • Invisible Form Factors: Custom-crafted Completely-in-Canal (CIC) and Invisible-in-Canal (IIC) designs that hide completely inside the ear canal.

Our Comprehensive Diagnostic & Fitting Protocol

At Micro Hearing Care Centre in Uttara (Dhaka) and Chandana Chowrasta (Gazipur), every fitting follows rigorous clinical audiology protocols:

  1. Pure Tone Audiometry (PTA) in certified soundproof booths.
  2. Tympanometry and acoustic reflex testing to check middle ear and eardrum function.
  3. Computerized Real-Ear Measurement (REM) programming tailored to each patient's individual ear canal acoustics.
  4. Routine 6-monthly servicing, ultrasonic dehumidification, and warranty protection.

We invite you and your family to visit our clinics for a complimentary hearing consultation and live demonstration of the latest digital hearing aids.

title: How to Clean & Protect Hearing Aids in Humid Weather
author: Audiology Technical Lab, MHCC
excerpt: Essential maintenance tips for Bangladesh's humid seasons: using drying capsules, clearing earwax cerumen guards, and protecting micro-receivers.
content:
Bangladesh experiences high relative humidity and warm temperatures for the greater part of the year. For sensitive electronic devices worn directly against human skin—such as hearing aids—atmospheric moisture and perspiration represent the primary causes of unexpected malfunction.

Understanding the Moisture Threat

A digital hearing aid contains miniature microphones, balanced armature receivers, and microprocessors. When sweat or ambient moisture enters the casing, it can oxidize battery contacts, corrode solder joints, and degrade acoustic dampening filters.

5 Essential Daily Care Habits for Humid Climates

1. Nightly Dehumidifier Box Storage

Never leave your hearing aids out on a dressing table or bathroom counter overnight. Always open the battery door (or turn off rechargeable units) and place them inside a sealed drying jar containing active silica gel desiccant capsules or an electronic UV-C sanitizing dry-box.

2. Daily Cerumen (Earwax) Inspection

Earwax naturally softens in hot, humid weather and can migrate into the receiver dome or earmould sound bore. Use the stiff-bristle brush provided in your MHCC maintenance kit to brush down the wax guard each morning before inserting the device.

3. Never Wear Devices in the Shower or Rain

While modern premium hearing aids (such as Phonak Lumity or Rexton Arena) carry IP68 water resistance ratings, this rating is designed for accidental splashes—not prolonged immersion. Always remove your hearing aids before showering, swimming, or walking in heavy monsoon downpours.

4. Allow Batteries to 'Breathe'

If you use disposable Zinc-Air batteries (size 10, 312, 13, or 675), peel off the adhesive sticker and wait a full 60 to 90 seconds before inserting the battery. This allows atmospheric oxygen to fully energize the chemical cell, preventing voltage drops caused by trapped internal humidity.

5. Free Professional Ultrasonic Cleaning at MHCC

All hearing aids purchased through Micro Hearing Care Centre include complimentary lifetime routine vacuum cleaning and acoustic retuning at our Uttara and Gazipur branches. Bring your devices in every 6 months for professional servicing.

title: Early Signs of Hearing Loss in Children & Toddlers
author: Dr. Audiology Team, MHCC
excerpt: A parent’s guide to identifying delayed speech development, lack of startle response to loud sounds, and pediatric hearing screening solutions.
content:
A child's ability to develop spoken language, learn at school, and build social confidence relies entirely on clear hearing during the critical first three years of life. When pediatric hearing loss goes undetected, language milestones are missed and school performance suffers.

Age-Specific Red Flags for Parents

Infants (0 to 6 Months)

  • Does not startle, blink, or jump at sudden loud noises (such as a door slamming).
  • Does not turn head or eyes toward a parent's speaking voice by 4 to 6 months.
  • Seems to hear only loud vibrating sounds and ignores softer environmental cues.

Toddlers (7 to 18 Months)

  • Does not turn directly toward their name being called from across the room.
  • Does not imitate common simple vocal sounds ('ba-ba', 'ma-ma', 'da-da').
  • Relies predominantly on visual gestures and pointing instead of vocalizing.

Preschool & School-Age Children

  • Speaks noticeably louder than other children of the same age.
  • Frequently asks "What?", "Pardon?", or turns the television to excessively high volumes.
  • Teacher reports inattentiveness, daydreaming, or behavioral restlessness in the classroom.
  • Unclear articulation of consonant sounds (substituting 't' for 'k' or missing 's' and 'sh').

Specialized Pediatric Care at Micro Hearing Care Centre

Pediatric audiology requires specialized diagnostic equipment and child-friendly fitting expertise. At MHCC:

  • Visual Reinforcement & Play Audiometry: Interactive tests where children play engaging games whenever they hear a tone, keeping them calm and cooperative.
  • Tamperproof Pediatric Hearing Aids: Phonak Sky models with locked battery compartments, indicator lights for parents, and hypoallergenic custom-moulded silicone earmoulds.
  • Roger Wireless FM Classroom Integration: Allows schoolteachers' voices to stream directly into the child's hearing aids, overcoming distance and noisy schoolrooms.

If you notice any warning signs in your infant or child, contact Micro Hearing Care Centre immediately for early developmental screening.
